lines.t: Wake up…
Open your eyes…
The night is long, but truth is near…
Wake up…
You’ve been walking in a dream they sold you,
Lights so bright you never saw the chains.
Voices talking, but they never told you
Who is whispering your name.
Every screen is just a mirror of lies,
Every promise turns to dust and smoke.
You keep searching for a sign, a sign—
But the sign is in the words you spoke.
Can you feel it in your chest?
Can you hear it through the noise?
They say, “Sleep, it’s for the best,”
But the truth has got a voice.
Wake up! Open your eyes!
The world is fake, but truth won’t die.
Wake up! No more disguise!
[Drop]
“Wake… up… open… your… eye…”
Who’s asleep?
Who?
Who’s awake?
Who?
Who’s asleep?
Who?
Who’s awake?
Who?
They built walls inside your mind so quiet,
Filled your head with endless, hollow sound.
You were taught to trade your soul for “viral,”
While your heart was bleeding underground.
But there’s a letter written in the fire,
Every word a blade that cuts the veil.
Can you feel it in your chest?
Can you hear it through the noise?
They say, “Sleep, it’s for the best,”
But the truth has got a voice.
Wake up! Open your eyes!
The world is fake, but truth won’t die.
Wake up! No more disguise!
You were never meant to live like this
Half-alive, half-blind, half-breath.
There is a Word that splits the darkness,
Wake up…
Open your eye…
The night is long…
But truth is near…
Wake up…
